remarks: The Somerset is a private, intimate condominium complex of just 8 units, offering an ideal blend of comfort, style, and convenience. Perfectly located within walking distance to the Glenbrook train station and just minutes from downtown Stamford, this sun filled end unit 3BR 2.5BA townhouse delivers the best of modern living across three spacious levels. Step inside to newly refinished hardwood floors that flow throughout the open living area, which features a cozy gas fireplace and sliders leading out to a private deck - ideal for entertaining or enjoying quiet moments outdoors. Spacious dining area and the well appointed kitchen shines with sleek stainless steel appliances and ample cabinet space. On the second level, you'll find two generously sized bedrooms and a full bath, making it an ideal space for family, guests, or a home office. The top level is dedicated to the expansive primary suite, a true retreat with vaulted ceilings, a jetted tub, a walk-in closet, and beautiful builtins for added style and storage. Additional highlights include gas heating, central air, a dedicated laundry room with a full-size washer and dryer, and an attached two car garage for ultimate convenience. With three levels of living space, quality finishes, and a serene, welcoming setting, The Somerset is a rare find and a perfect place to call home. Come experience it for yourself and discover why this exceptional residence is truly one of a kind!
